<MethodEndpoint method={'post'} path={'/v1/admin/workflows'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

Stores the document as a draft in the family its `id` names, creating the family in the `users` scope when it is new; a `name` of 1 to 200 characters labels a family this call creates. The document is not compiled, so a draft may be saved while still invalid. A family holds at most one draft, and a draft never starts an onboarding.
